fixes.explanation: Verse 4 says, "His lightning illuminates the world; the earth sees and trembles." The earth sees the light, and it trembles. I think I'd be shaking right along with it, like my mustache when I forget the oven timer and hear it go off behind me.

Verse 4 isn't the only loud one here. Verse 10 opens with, "Hate evil, O you who love the LORD!" Notice who it's aimed at: people who already love Him. Then it keeps going: "He preserves the souls of His saints; He delivers them from the hand of the wicked." I think that's the reason for the command, friend. Loving Him and hating evil go together, and He's the One who keeps hold of you while you do it.
